units.source_text: 我并不想在这里与海亲切会见。

en.t: I did not want to have an intimate encounter with the sea here.

units.source_text: 吉普车也许会从后面驶来，半开玩笑地把我植入海里。

en.t: A jeep might come driving up from behind and, half jokingly, plant me in the sea.

units.source_text: 现在回想起来，激发我做这番旅行的冲动中，有海的启示，

en.t: Looking back now, among the impulses that stirred me to make this journey was a revelation from the sea,

units.source_text: 这海恐怕不是那种人工港口的海，

en.t: and that sea was probably not the sea of such an artificial harbor,

units.source_text: 而是幼时在成生呷故乡接触过的、天生的、自然形象的、汹涌澎湃的海。

en.t: but the sea I had known in childhood at my home near Cape Nariu: innate, natural in form, and surging wildly.

units.source_text: 是粗矿豪放的、始终含着怒气的、令人烦躁的里日本的海。

en.t: It was the Sea of Japan on the far side: rough and expansive, always holding anger within it, and irritating to the nerves.
